items.title: Triage the 71 records asserting a mapping their own research report advised against
items.body:
## Finding

`scripts/validate_records_against_research.py` (#309) compares each ingredient
record against the deep-research report for that same ingredient. Over the 527
records researched so far it found **71 `STATUS_CONFLICT`s** — the record asserts
an ontology mapping while its own report recommended `UNMAPPED`.

**Every one of them was written by the same mechanical sweep,
`promote_resolved_unmapped`.** That is the #203/#263 pattern recurring: a
plausible identifier promoted by a mechanism that never decided anything.

## Important caveat — do not treat all 71 as defects

The Edison/PaperQA3 lane cannot open an ontology page. Its reports say so
verbatim ("no ChEBI CURIE was verified in the retrieved evidence"), so it
defaults to "retain UNMAPPED" whenever it cannot confirm a term — which is most
of the time. An Edison "retain UNMAPPED" on its own is therefore weak evidence.

That is exactly why the second (Claude) lane exists, and it already resolved 22
of these: `LANE_DISAGREEMENT_RESOLVED` marks a conflict the Claude lane cleared
by resolving the term Edison could not. Those 22 need no action.

## Triage order

Work `mappings/record_research_validation.md`, most severe first:

1. **17 `BOTH_LANES_DISPUTE`** — both independent lanes dispute the mapping.
   Strongest signal in the ledger; start here.
2. **`P1 CURIE_REFUTED`** — a report names the record's exact CURIE and argues
   against it. The quoted line usually names the right term.
3. **`P1 VERDICT_REFUTES`** — a per-field verdict table refutes an identity
   field and supplies a corrected value.
4. The remainder of the `STATUS_CONFLICT`s, checking `promoted_by` and
   `documented_rationale`.

Each row carries the quoted report line that produced it, so most are a one-read
decision: keep with a written justification, downgrade `mapping_quality`, or
demote.

## Note on coverage

The ledger currently covers 527 of 2,841 records; the Edison sweep is ongoing
(~30 records/hour, account-capped). Re-run the validator as it completes — these
counts will grow.

items.title: Apply #312 batch 1: five regrades and five parent re-anchors, through the review chain
items.body:
Closes #742. Closes #743.

Part of #312 (user ruling: verify the 36 unrefuted proposals inline, apply survivors in batches by shape through the review bundle). This is batch 1: the corrections that change **no identifier**. Each proposal was re-verified against `chebi.db`; the mutator re-checks every ChEBI fact it relies on at run time and refuses to write if one no longer holds.

## Records (11)

| shape | record | change | why |
|---|---|---|---|
| regrade | 5-Hydroxydodecanoate | EXACT → SYNONYM | label is a related synonym; primary label is `5-hydroxylaurate` |
| regrade | Caproic_Acid | EXACT → SYNONYM | `caproic acid` is a related synonym of `hexanoic acid` |
| regrade | Hydroxystreptomycin | CLOSE → SYNONYM | unique related synonym of CHEBI:24750 |
| regrade | D-galactonic_Acid_Lactone | SYNONYM → CLOSE | not a ChEBI name; ring size supplied from outside (bare `D-Galactonolactone` names the 1,5-lactone) |
| regrade | Glutamyl-glutamic_Acid | SYNONYM → CLOSE | not a ChEBI name; alpha/L,L supplied by convention; gamma isomer is CHEBI:73705 |
| parent | 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium_Acetate | CHEBI:61326 (bare cation) → CHEBI:63895 ionic liquid | the cation is a part, not a broader term (Section 6); sibling record uses the same parent |
| parent | 2-oxobutyric_Acid_Sodium_Salt | CHEBI:16763 anion → CHEBI:30831 acid | Section 3: the parent follows the label; the "ChEBI has no acid term" premise (#322 and the worked example in MAPPING_SEMANTICS) was false |
| parent | 3-sialyllactose_Sodium_Salt | CHEBI:26714 `sodium salt` → CHEBI:151472 | ChEBI has 3'-sialyllactose (synonym, cas:35890-38-1); the NO_PARENT claim was false |
| parent | 6-O-sialyllactose_Sodium_Salt | CHEBI:26714 → CHEBI:153372 | synonyms `6'-sialyllactose`, `6'SL` |
| parent | Arabinan_From_Sugar_Beet | FOODON `sugar beet` → CHEBI:22590 arabinan | the matcher grounded the source qualifier, not the head noun |
| tombstone | Mgcl2x_6_H2o (REJECTED) | ontology row CHEBI:6636 → CHEBI:86345; anhydrous alias REJECTED_LABEL | the #414 merge re-pointed the identifier but left the anhydrous mapping (#232) |

Own-identifier rows keep `skos:exactMatch` (Rule D); justification/confidence follow the grade as the builder writes them. `reconcile_sssom --apply` synced the five parent rows and their registry-row comments. Two stray `Propionate (sodium salt)` tokens leave the sialyllactose rows' `other` column.

## Review chain

The completion lock (#729–#731) only admitted synonym-only refreshes verified by the pinned producer. `assemble_review.py` now chains **mapping-change receipts** (`mapping_changes/<batch>.json`, written by `make_receipt.py` from the mutator's apply log) after them. A receipt records the SSSOM digest before/after, every owner's before/after YAML hash with its verification, every changed/added/removed row, and a position map so position-keyed cohorts and holds carry forward. The assembler **withholds every touched row** and never turns a receipt into an approval; owners it touches lose the byte-identical carry-forward.

| | before | after |
|---|---:|---:|
| completion SUPPORTED / WITHHOLD | 1763 / 1255 | 1759 / 1259 |
| resolution assertions APPROVED / OPEN (all kinds) | 2272 / 2251 | 2268 / 2255 |
| findings moved | — | 0 |

## Deferred, not applied

- **Arabinoxylan_Rye_Flour** parent anchor (CHEBI:28427): the resolution review pins that record's 2026-09-21 identity-plan state and refuses any later edit. Filed separately.
- The other 25 proposals (identity swaps, registry mints, merges) are later batches; #16 Angustmycin needs a curator call (filed separately).

## Review findings

Filed and fixed here: #742 (a row touched by two receipts failed the chain check; the assembler now replays the receipts and compares the replay to the source) and #743 (no tests; `tests/test_mapping_change_receipt.py` covers alignment, position maps, double-touched rows and every refusal). Deferrals filed: #740 (resolution identity-plan pin blocks the Arabinoxylan parent anchor), #741 (Angustmycin label is ambiguous; curator call).

## Checks run

`just validate-all`, `qc-sssom`, `qc-roundtrip`, `qc-flat-coverage` (after `export-lists`/`export-browser`), `validate-products` (id-label), `qc-evidence` (with CLAW_ROOT), `qc-duplicate-ids`, `qc-component-partonomy`, `check-instruction-refs`: all OK. `reconcile_sssom.py` check: in sync. Both review products exported and validated from clean output directories. Focused pytest (lock, grading, exports, semantic review): 191 passed.
